summary.one_liner: A Next.js 15 and Tailwind CSS storefront template that connects to a Medusa commerce backend, deprecated in favor of dtc-starter.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is a Next.js storefront starter for the Medusa ecommerce backend, built with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. The README lists product detail and overview pages, product collections, a cart, Stripe checkout, user accounts, and order details. It also covers Next.js 15 features such as the App Router, server components, server actions, streaming, and static pre-rendering. Setup assumes a Medusa server running locally on port 9000, and the README points to create-medusa-app for that. The README says the repository is deprecated and recommends the dtc-starter instead.
use_cases: connect a storefront to a Medusa backend
add Stripe checkout to a web shop
prototype a product catalog with cart and accounts
notable: Full storefront flow: product pages, collections, cart, checkout, accounts, and order details
Uses Next.js 15 App Router with server components and server actions
Stripe payment integration enabled through an environment variable
caveats: The README says this repository is deprecated and points to dtc-starter instead
Requires a running Medusa server on local port 9000
Stripe must also be configured on the Medusa server side
